scope: Actual GeckoView 157, real extension-to-native payload and DOM work; actual Android scroll and keyboard input; 240 historical messages and 105k current reply. Subsequent same-route DOM restoration, exact-identity SPA allocation, website socket faults and native completion-stability regression; no real account or external site. RAF and Android Choreographer timings are descriptive, no cross-device FPS threshold.

scrollDiagnostics.instrumentationScope: Read-only scroll-phase diagnostics add passive DOM listeners, bounded native touch/delegate capture, geometry and existing before/after snapshots. This passive layer adds no evaluations or changes to polling, timeouts, assertions or typing. Native injection uses the separately declared fixed UiAutomation protocol; controller startup and event timing remain recorded. First four busy samples are unchanged; APZ touch dispatch, scroll-phase scheduling and frame timing may be affected by the added work and passive touch listeners.
